findings.reason: an implementer reading the decision block would add a second, ownerless edge beside DOCUMENTS, exactly the duplicate the plan's §3 forbids.
findings.text: the `signal-metadata-slots`… `dynamic-page-handling` decision rationale still says every scanned FacilitySignal links to its page "through DOCUMENTED_IN", while §3 body and the acted-on review comment use the existing `DOCUMENTS` relationship owned by `WikiChunk.documents_signals` (imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:3831); `grep -rn DOCUMENTED_IN imas_codex/` returns nothing, so the decision text names an edge with no owner and contradicts the plan's own rule against "a second edge with a second owner"

findings.reason: all four families are at 0 this week so no ceiling is approached, and §3 already accounts for the enum family by keeping WikiPageStatus closed; the omission is a formality rather than a design risk.
findings.text: §3 adds a `fronts_database` property to WikiPage (new interface surface, absent from imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml, confirmed by `grep -rn fronts_database imas_codex/`) without naming what it retires or merges, or stating why nothing can be

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new shallow-wrapper family is proposed; §6's remote_environment is merged by one resolver in the facility-aware layer and passed to a deliberately facility-agnostic executor, and §2/§3 add a schema slot and a scorer rule rather than new modules.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the decision block still routes the handbook-page linkage through a `DOCUMENTED_IN` edge, which exists nowhere in the codebase and would fork the owner at imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:3831.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §6 names its retirement (`data_access_patterns.setup_commands` removed from schema and tcv.yaml) and §2 names the unreleased keywords stopgap it replaces, but §3 adds the `fronts_database` property on WikiPage without naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the existing owner for each mechanism it extends: §3 reuses `WikiChunk.documents_signals` / `[:DOCUMENTS]` (imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:3831, imas_codex/discovery/wiki/pipeline.py:281,319) rather than a new edge; §6 extends `_resolve_ssh_host`/`check_all_tools` (imas_codex/remote/tools.py:85,471) and `get_python_status`/`PythonVersion.meets_minimum` (imas_codex/remote/python.py:146,66); §4 cites the pypdf declaration.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §6 states why the existing probe and resolver are extended rather than supplemented ("the facility probe that already exists is extended, not duplicated"; "no new CLI command is added"), and §3 reuses the existing DOCUMENTS edge instead of a parallel one.
